description:
List the invoices this company issued, newest first.

One document type at a time: pass nfse for services or nfe for
goods. A company that issues both has to be asked twice.

Use it for "my last invoices", "what was rejected today", and to find
a document whose access key the user does not have at hand. Read-only.

An authorized document is stored as issued, which is the value the
rows carry; authorized is accepted as a synonym and asks for the
same thing.

Every row carries both identifiers the other tools need: id, which
reissue_invoice takes, and access_key, which consult_invoice,
cancel_invoice and get_invoice_pdf take. A rejected
row has an id and no access key — the authorizer never assigned one.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for, as list_authorized_companies shows it. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_id.title: Company Id

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for — the company using Stackin, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Punctuation is ignored. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_tax_id.title: Company Tax Id

include_items.description: Keep each row's item lines and fiscal_operation. Off by default: they are most of the size, and a page of 100 NF-e with them is about 130 KB. consult_invoice brings one document's lines back.
include_items.title: Include Items

name: list_invoices

InvoiceListItem.description: One row of the issuance history.
InvoiceListItem.title: InvoiceListItem

outputSchema.description: A page of documents this company issued, newest first.

total.description: How many exist, not how many are here.
total.title: Total

outputSchema.title: InvoiceList
